findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Functional. Handback clears `pending` and releases the lock here, but leaves `native_round` in the item record. For a completed task whose status is still `working`, `nextstep._item` (src/forge/nextstep.py:702-709) treats that marker and the absent lock as a stopped worker. `forge next` then tells the coordinator to run `forge work` again instead of proceeding to close. The new test checks `forge next` only while the round is pending.
findings.title: Successful handback makes forge next say the worker stopped

stop.reason: Owner rule for Harm 1-2: a third angle on land and handed-out rounds; when the session exits before handback, a land rerun closes only the committed work, the same as a normal close, with nothing lost. Filed as a follow-up for the next tools part
